{"type":"text","timestamp":1794688267920,"sessionID":"ses_e2440213effeDffE7p6BI1JFPM","part":{"id":"prt_1dbc1b191001exTEkzQCZ1Uu4h","messageID":"msg_1dbc19042001eKEL44vxpHJ036","sessionID":"ses_e2440213effeDffE7p6BI1JFPM","type":"text","text":"The shift ended at minute 120 with all four customer-facing services at 0% errors and no throttles still on. I found and fixed three separate causes. The cost of each mitigation is my estimate, not the scored total.\n\n1. **mobile-api (97% errors at the page):**\n   - **Cause:** pricing-svc was overloaded. Failed calls were being retried, pricing's own traffic had roughly tripled to about 2,800 requests/s, and sms-svc (which pricing depends on) got a bad deploy, v156, at minute -8. That deploy switched the message format to v3, so sms-svc logged `DecodeError: unknown wire schema 'v3'`.\n   - **Fix:** I limited incoming traffic to pricing-svc (turned away 90% of requests) to break the retry loop, then rolled back sms-svc's deploy.\n   - **Follow-up:** sms-svc was still overloaded after the rollback, so I limited it to 50% for a few minutes and then lifted that.\n   - **Capacity:** I scaled pricing-svc from 6 to 14 instances to handle the higher traffic, then removed its traffic limit. It runs at about 71% CPU.\n\n2. **partner-api (about 4.5% errors on $18,100/min of revenue):**\n   - **Cause:** quotes-svc deploy v59 hardcoded its database connection pool to 4. returns-svc calls to quotes-svc then timed out waiting for a connection, and those failures passed up through search-svc to partner-api.\n   - **Fix:** quotes-svc was near full CPU, and a rollback fails 30% of requests while it runs, which could have set off another retry overload. So I first scaled it from 6 to 10 instances, then rolled back v59, then set it back to 6.\n   - **Cost of this approach:** partner-api ran at about 33% errors for the few minutes the rollback took.\n\n3. **web-storefront (98% errors from minute 47, a new fault during the shift):**\n   - **Cause:** address-svc config change cfg-20 removed `currency` from its price fields, causing `KeyError: 'currency'`.\n   - **Fix:** I reverted that config. A code deploy (v118) went out at the same minute, but it didn't touch this and I left it alone.\n\n**Remaining cost:** pricing-svc is still at 14 instances, 8 above normal, which costs about $24/min (scaling, so not charged as wasted). No other service was given an action it didn't need. cart-svc stayed at about 99% CPU throughout, but nothing customer-facing calls it, so I left it alone. The 400-call cap was never close to being reached.","time":{"start":1794688266641,"end":1794688267912}}}
